source.title: Yellow-pine chipmunk (variant of Townsend's chipmunk on the California ground squirrel's Meshy mesh)
source.author: variant of tamias_townsendii by agent (Claude) for Aaron Brodeur
source.original: the California ground squirrel's text-to-3D preview, ai_model latest (meshy-7.1), triangle remesh to 20,000 faces (19,627 triangles, untextured)
source.prompt: (the ground squirrel's) A California ground squirrel (Otospermophilus beecheyi) walking on all four legs like a squirrel crossing a lawn: NOT sitting, NOT standing up, NOT a prairie dog, NOT a marmot, NOT a chipmunk. Single adult, side-on, body horizontal and long, back level, all four paws flat on the ground, front legs straight down under the shoulders, head held up and forward. Realistic proportions: head and body 26 cm, body a little heavier than a tree squirrel's but not fat, short legs, rounded head, small erect rounded ears, blunt muzzle, open dark eyes. Bushy flattened tail 18 cm long (two thirds of the body), wider than the hind leg, held straight out behind and level, not curled. Mottled grey-brown fur, pale grey shoulders, buff belly. No base, no ground. Game-ready, symmetric.

tiers.note: tools/build_chipmunk.py's build at the smaller size with the yellow-pine palette: the back cut along the stripe edges on lod0 and lod1; lod0 = body 1,186 + tail (10 x 12, 240) + eyes (16); lod1 = 402 + tail (6 x 7, 84); lod2 = 126 (no stripe cuts: a dark median and muted bands) + tail (4 x 3, 24). GLB 167,232 bytes.

rig: Rodent template, exactly as client/assets/ground_squirrel.glb and chipmunk.glb (tools/build_chipmunk.py) and to be loaded with the chipmunk's constants: BODY 0 (hindquarters), CHEST 7 (pivot at the lumbar), HEAD 6 (pivot at the base of the neck) and LEG_A 1 (fore pair, elbows) children of the chest, LEG_B 2 (hind pair, stifles), TAIL 3 and TAIL_TIP 8 (child of the tail). extras.rig keys: kind 'rodent', chest [0, 0.0457, -0.0224], tail [0, 0.0305, -0.0425], tail_tip [0, 0.0388, -0.0829], head [0, 0.0343, 0.04], fore [0.0091, 0.0161, 0.0237], hind [0.011, 0.0123, -0.0428], length_m 0.21. No skin.
accuracy_notes: Reads as a bright chipmunk, crisper than Townsend's: five black dorsal stripes, the outer pale pair white and the inner pair grey, bright tawny-orange sides, a greyish rump and thighs, a white belly, the face boldly striped black and white, ears blackish in front and whitish behind, the tail blackish above edged buff and tawny-orange below. Shares Townsend's limits: the ground squirrel's body slimmed 0.86x is a little long and short-legged for a chipmunk and its head is blunt; the tail from above reads mostly dark (the buff edge shows from the side); lod2 has no stripes (a dark median).

scientific_note: GBIF and the tile records file it as Tamias amoenus; many authors now place the western chipmunks in Neotamias (Neotamias amoenus).
